title: Biostratigraphic data for the Cretaceous marine sediments in the USGS-St. George No. 1 core (DOR-211), Dorchester County, South Carolina
citation: Self-Trail, Jean, and Gohn, Gregory, 1996, Biostratigraphic data for the Cretaceous marine sediments in the USGS-St. George No. 1 core (DOR-211), Dorchester County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-96-684, map scale 1:455,000.
notes: Biostratigraphic report on the St. George core (DOR-211). Intervals 522-1,322 ft follow this report's provisional stratigraphy (p. 5); intervals below 1,322 ft are Renken's earlier assignments (in Reid and others, 1986) quoted on p. 2. The report also cites Renken's older picks for the upper section (Black Creek 1,322-1,088 ft, Peedee 1,088-560 ft, Black Mingo 560-530 ft); not recorded as intervals because this report revises them. Nannofossil range charts (figs. 3-4) are garbled in the text layer and species lists/ostracode count tables were not recorded value by value. References: recorded Carolina-relevant ones; skipped general European, Gulf Coast and New Jersey zonation papers.
